title_en: What Have You Been Up To?
grammar_focus: KS4/28/52 现在完成时 vs 现在完成进行时(教材 L76 Key structures,方案B换情节包):现在完成 has/have done(结果、经历,如 have taken/have learned/have found)、现在完成进行 has/have been doing(持续过程,如 have been studying/have been working/have been painting)、两者对比、以及 since(时间点)/ for(时段)
scene: “我好久没见你了!”埃玛说,“你最近在忙什么?”“从一月起我一直在学摄影,”利奥说,“我已经拍了几百张照片了,也学到了好多。”“太好了!我一直在咖啡馆打工,不过一直没多少空闲时间。”“你的画画完了吗?”利奥问。“还没——我已经画了三个星期了,不过快好了。”“那咱俩都挺忙的。”“是啊,但我们终于挤出一个下午见面了!”“我一直很想念这些闲聊,”埃玛笑着说。“我也是。下次别隔这么久了。”

grammar_card.title: KS4/28/52 现在完成 vs 现在完成进行 + since/for
grammar_card.intro: 两种时态都连着“过去到现在”,但侧重不同:①现在完成 have/has done——强调“结果、已完成、经历”(I have taken hundreds of photos 已经拍了;I have learned a lot 学到了);②现在完成进行 have/has been doing——强调“一直在做、持续的过程”(I have been studying photography 一直在学;I have been painting it 一直在画)。时间词:since + 时间点(since January);for + 一段时间(for three weeks / for ages)。疑问与否定:Have you…? / haven't done。

rows: I have taken hundreds of photos already.
现在完成进行(持续过程)
I have been studying photography since January.
have learned(学到了) vs have been studying(一直在学)
since + 时间点 / for + 时段
Have you finished? / I haven't had much time.

specialRules.rule: 美语里“公寓”说 apartment(英式 flat)、“假期”说 vacation(英式 holiday)、“电梯”说 elevator(英式 lift);本课已按美语写。
强调“做出的结果/数量/是否完成”用现在完成(have done);强调“一直在进行、还没停”用现在完成进行(have been doing)。since 接时间点,for 接一段时间。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Why haven't Emma and Leo met for so long?
options: They have both been very busy

passage: "I haven't seen you for ages!" said Emma. "What have you been doing?" "I have been studying photography since January," said Leo. "I have taken hundreds of photos already, and I have learned so much." "That's great! I have been working at the café, but I haven't had much free time." "Have you finished your painting?" Leo asked. "Not yet — I have been painting it for three weeks, but it's almost done." "We have both been busy, then." "Yes, but we have finally found an afternoon to meet!" "I have missed these chats," Emma said with a smile. "So have I. Let's not wait so long next time."
